requirement_text: Core-task steps p95 ≤ 2 s; task p95 ≤ 5 s; effect in mail path p95 ≤ 60 s
scope: mail-path time-to-effect (60 s bound) and instrumented core-task step/task journeys
record_type: time-to-effect harness result and nightly browser journey result

worker_ttl_contract.note: alias record plus __global_blocklist, suspended_users and rate_limited_users; this TTL is what bounds production staleness to 60 s

caveats: Miniflare 3 does not emulate Cloudflare KV cacheTtl staleness; the measured publish-to-observe values are the propagation floor, not the worst-case cached read.
The 60 s production bound is enforced by the cacheTtl:60 reads in worker/src/index.ts (verified above), not measured through an emulated edge cache.

instrumentation.assertion_note: Timed steps/tasks assert configured budgets and capture Server-Timing on measured API responses; this run is recorded as a passing budget-compliance sample (no separate per-step duration artifact emitted by these specs).
